_comment: Gameplay sound effects. tools/generate_gameplay_sfx.py asks ElevenLabs for each missing source (tools/audio_sources/sfx/gameplay/<id>.mp3, with '/' as '__'); tools/build_gameplay_audio.py levels and encodes them into game/assets/audio/. 'level' is the loudest 100 ms RMS in dBFS; the music sits near -18 LUFS (about -15 dBFS loudest 100 ms). 'steps' sources are sliced into variants (<cue>_1.ogg ...); 'loop' sources get a seamless crossfaded loop.
